provenance.author: pilot writer (Claude Opus 5.5, model-written)
notes: Revised from the design calibration sample (docs/welsh-v2-sample-chapter.json) for continuity with Penodau 1–5. All sample segment and section IDs are kept; new segments are s113–s120.

Changes: Modlen's discovery that the smoke comes from the hat is now her speech (s089, s113); new closing exchange in which Cynyr asks the chapter's title question and Mali, who cannot lie, answers truthfully only because the hat has just left the kitchen (s114–s119); Dafi says one word, 'Llawn!' (s120, §6.4); s054/s056/s104 now carry speakers; the s098–s102 glance chain is marked as the declared tableau.
Gloss fixes: the Oes paradigm gloss moved from s041 (anchor not present) to s042; radical glosses added for 'y gynffon' (s078) and 'ddrwg' (s085).

Pensa fixes: A9 is now a G02 recall (G05 was only one chapter back); B1, B5, B7 and B9 rewritten so no story sentence is copied; B bank extended (gofyn, hefyd) so each gap has at least three same-part-of-speech candidates.

After model review: oes is now recorded as a verb (existential present of bod) and nac oes / does dim as phrases; the Gramadeg note says indefinite subject and personal pronoun, and the table adds plât Cai to show that a possessed noun is definite without an article.
Media refs renamed from cy-p06-* to the cy-brenin-01-l06-img-* convention (no media files exist yet).

Running words 853, about 3% over the advisory 675–825 window: the closing exchange (s114–s125) carries the chapter title and lifts dialogue to the ≥30% target, and s126–s128 recycle brawd, chwaer and tref for the next-five-chapter recall check; narration was trimmed (s037, s047, s065, s075 removed). Every remaining sentence carries an event or a joke.
Continuity with Pennod 5: Myrddin arrived the night before; his hat sits by the fire, as in the tower; Cynyr and Elen still do not know Dafi exists.

review_questions.question: [?] Is 'het fawr, het ddu, het dawel' natural (personified 'quiet hat')?
[?] Is the question-and-fragment 'Dan y bwrdd? Pero.' acceptable narration, or does it read as a fronted focus?
[?] Identification 'Pero yw'r ci drwg' vs classification 'Mae Pero'n gi drwg': natural in Cai's mouth?
[?] Personal names left unmutated after i/ar/wrth (course policy §2.3). Confirm acceptable.
[?] 'a dim bara!' (and no bread) as a verbless exclamation: natural for Cynyr?
[?] Mali's literally-true denial depends on the hat having just left the kitchen (s117). Is the joke clear enough from 'mae Myrddin a'r het yn y buarth nawr'?
[?] 'meddai Dafi yn yr het' (said Dafi in the hat): acceptable placement of the location after the speech tag?

grammar.nodyn_en: Use oes / does dim when the subject is indefinite (Oes bara? 'Is there any bread?'). Use ydy / dyw … ddim when the subject is definite: y/yr/'r + noun, a name, a personal pronoun, or a possessed noun like plât Cai (Ydy plât Cai …?). Answer with the same verb: Oes → Oes / Nac oes.
